title: eragrostis palisotii
intro: Eragrostis palisotii, commonly known as Guinea grass, is a perennial grass species belonging to the family Poaceae. The health benefits of Eragrostis palisotii include its ability to improve digestion, lower blood sugar levels, and possess antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as a demulcent, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic, making it effective in treating conditions such as dysuria, fever, and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of Eragrostis palisotii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
